_note: Hero copy, subheading, brand statement and CTA labels are VERBATIM from punarjiva.in — do not paraphrase without the client's sign-off.
_backgroundNote: Header background photograph. Swap for a real store photo by putting a file in assets/images/ and using a project-relative path like 'assets/images/storeFront.jpg'. backgroundTint controls readability over it: 'strong' (most legible), '' (default), or 'light' (photo shows through most). Remove backgroundImage entirely to fall back to the plain brand gradient.
heroTitle: Organic purity, ancient strength, true Punarjivam.
heroSubtitle: Punarjiva Organics brings together organic groceries, natural cosmetics and Ayurvedic energy boosters chosen to support everyday wellness — grounded in tradition, curated with care.
heroImageAlt: A vegetable curry served with flatbread beside a copper pot
_ctaNote: ctaCallLabel / ctaWhatsappLabel / ctaDirectionsLabel are shared by every page, so they live in data/ctaActions.json rather than being repeated here. Edit them there once and the hero, all CTA sections and the contact page update together.
statementText: The body deserves Punarjivam — a revival powered by organic purity and ancient natural strength.
aboutTeaserText: Created by health-conscious minds, Punarjiva Organics is dedicated to reviving the body's natural harmony through organic foods, nature-led care and time-tested Ayurvedic wisdom.
_purityNote: Deliberately NOT certification badges. Nothing here claims a certificate, an award or a lab result, because none has been verified. Each line is a description of how the shop actually buys — if any of these stops being true, delete the line rather than softening it.

purityMarks.title: Sourced, not resold
purityMarks.text: We buy from farms and small makers we can name.

purityMarks.title: Nothing hidden
purityMarks.text: Unpolished, unrefined, and labelled as such.

purityMarks.title: Ask us anything
purityMarks.text: If we do not know where it came from, we say so.

purityMarks.title: Small, frequent batches
purityMarks.text: Fresh stock beats a full shelf.

productsIntro: A focused selection of organic groceries, natural cosmetics and Ayurvedic energy boosters — to gently bring Punarjivam into your daily routine.
_featureNote: Which products appear in the spotlight, the best-seller rail and the 'just in' row is decided by the `badges` array on each product in data/products.json — 'featured', 'bestseller', 'new', 'seasonal'. Only the wording lives here. Move a badge in that file and these sections change with it; no HTML or JS edit.
bestSellersIntro: The handful people come back for, in the order they are asked for.
freshIntro: Recently added, or only around for part of the year.
blogTeaserIntro: Notes on millets, cold-pressed oils, Ayurvedic staples and reading an ingredient list honestly.
visitTeaserText: Step into a space crafted to feel serene, grounded and close to nature. Explore, ask and choose at your own pace.
